title: Harden SSH: bind sshd to Tailscale only, close public port 22
description: Make the Lightsail flashgen-mcp instance reachable for SSH only over Tailscale. Steps: (1) bind sshd to Tailscale IP + loopback via /etc/ssh/sshd_config ListenAddress, disable password auth and root login, (2) reload sshd and verify with ss -ltnp, (3) confirm a fresh ssh flashgen-mcp session still works, (4) remove the public SSH (TCP 22) rule in the Lightsail IPv4/IPv6 firewall. Break-glass fallback remains the Lightsail browser-based SSH console in the AWS UI.
notes:
DONE this session (inside VM):
- Created /etc/systemd/system/ssh.socket.d/10-listen-tailscale.conf with ListenStream reset + bind to 100.84.134.120:22 (Tailscale) and 127.0.0.1:22 only
- systemd-analyze verify ssh.socket: OK
- systemctl daemon-reload + restart ssh.socket: active
- Verified ss -ltnp shows only Tailscale + loopback bindings (no 0.0.0.0:22, no [::]:22)
- Confirmed fresh SSH session works via Tailscale (ControlMaster disabled to bypass any multiplexing)
- PasswordAuthentication and KbdInteractiveAuthentication already 'no' from cloud-init defaults

REMAINING (user to do in AWS Lightsail console, NOT done yet):
- Delete SSH/TCP/22 rule in IPv4 firewall (Networking tab)
- Delete SSH/TCP/22 rule in IPv6 firewall (VM has public IPv6 2600:1f14:8c4:1200:f736:ac92:2c:d6ff, so this matters)
- Verify post-close: nc -vz -w 5 <pub-ipv4> 22 should time out; nc -vz -w 5 <pub-ipv6> 22 should time out; ssh flashgen-mcp should still work

Next session: confirm firewall closed, run verification commands, then bd close flashgen-qqq.

value: flashgen-mcp Lightsail instance is Ubuntu 24.04 with socket-activated sshd (ssh.socket enabled, ssh.service disabled). To restrict SSH binding, override /etc/systemd/system/ssh.socket.d/*.conf with 'ListenStream=' (empty reset) then specific addresses — editing sshd_config ListenAddress alone is IGNORED under socket activation. Current drop-in at 10-listen-tailscale.conf binds sshd to Tailscale IPv4 100.84.134.120:22 and 127.0.0.1:22 only. Tailscale IP of this VM: 100.84.134.120. Break-glass access: Lightsail browser SSH console in AWS UI (does not require public port 22).
